SOULSPIRE-ESTUS_FLASK.title: Estus Flask
SOULSPIRE-HOLLOW.description: Add a copy of this curse into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold]. It has [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
SOULSPIRE-HOLLOW.title: Hollow
SOULSPIRE-JOLLY_COOPERATION.description: Exhaust any number of cards in your hand. ALL players gain [gold]Energy[/gold] for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold].
SOULSPIRE-JOLLY_COOPERATION.title: Jolly Cooperation
SOULSPIRE-INVASION.description: Add 1 [gold]Dark Spirit[/gold] curse to the hand of a random ally. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
SOULSPIRE-INVASION.title: Invasion
SOULSPIRE-DARK_SPIRIT.description: If this is in your Hand at the end of your turn, gain {FrailPower:diff()} [gold]Frail[/gold] and {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] at the start of your next turn.
SOULSPIRE-DARK_SPIRIT.title: Dark Spirit
SOULSPIRE-PENDANT.description: A simple pendant with no effect. Can be traded at a Rest Site for 3 [gold]Relics[/gold].
SOULSPIRE-PENDANT.title: Pendant
